Epoxy Floors for Fort Knox Military Families & Contractors

Fort Knox is home to thousands of military families who cycle through PCS moves on tight timelines — and when you're getting ready to move in or prepare a home for inspection before a move-out, a fresh epoxy garage floor or basement coating can make a significant difference in how a property presents.

We've worked alongside military families and civilian housing contractors in the Fort Knox area for years. We know what BAH-conscious families need: competitive pricing, a clean process, minimal disruption, and a finished product that looks like it cost twice as much. We deliver all four.

Our process is the same here as everywhere we work: concrete moisture testing, diamond grinding for true mechanical adhesion, penetrating primer, base coat, full flake broadcast or solid color, and a urethane topcoat with our 15-year written warranty. We do not skip steps to get a job done faster — and we are transparent about every part of the process before we start.

Beyond residential work, we also serve civilian contractors and facility managers on projects near the installation. We carry proper licensing and insurance documentation required for base-adjacent work, and we can provide certificates of insurance quickly when required for contract purposes.
